purpose: Machine-readable evidence for the HIGH_SPREAD_CHOP boundary recalibration (2026-09-14 wave). Code defaults and hysteresis MUST agree with this file (pinned by tests/unit/test_bug281_chop_boundary_recalibration.py::test_calibration_evidence_file_agrees_with_code).

live_window.source: artifacts/audit.db audit_signals.spread_usd (broker ticks on the live account, PAPER decisions)

old_calibration.note: configs/execution_assumptions.json already records BOTH distributions and flags the ~3.7x p50 disagreement between windows; the live broker window is the authoritative substrate for the live engine.

chosen.rationale: enter ~p98 of the live window (genuine widening, e.g. session rolls/news, begins ~0.50 as the 09-11 19:59 tail shows); exit ~p75 keeps a WIDE hysteresis band so the Schmitt trigger cannot oscillate around normal noise; release is always immediate-safe (the guard is on the FREEZE side). Coherent veto ORDERING: candidate-relative gates (spread/ATR 0.18, spread/TP 0.15) evaluate entry COST vs setup geometry and stay; risk hard ceiling max_spread_points=60 == $0.60 USD (XAUUSD point=$0.01) remains ABOVE chop-enter: chop fires first, hard reject is the outer bound.
chosen.domain_note: ALL chop boundaries are USD (classifier rounds spread to cents, regime_classifier.py:243); risk max_spread_points is POINTS ($0.01/pt for XAUUSD). The unit mix was part of the original confusion; the ordering pin test converts to USD before comparing.
